lint.detail: the Hook has at most this many words
no copy asks a question
no copy uses a banned word
a post's frozen Hooks, in their own words, are exempt from these Hook rules: hook_max_words, banned_words_in_hook
every post caption ends with this one call-to-action line, carrying its platform's Waitlist Source link, and nothing else in a post is a call to action or a link
no copy uses social-proof language
no copy uses a banned character
no copy uses an emoji or other non-text symbol
no copy has an all-caps word outside all_caps_allowlist
all-caps words the all-caps rule allows
the layout of the dry-run creative briefs; a post Draft has its own format
screens shown as simulated; the kit's posts are real-device recordings
the Angle's sourced pain links its source with this prefix
no copy uses a stock phrase
capped words, counted per paragraph
how many capped words one paragraph may hold
a sentence with more words is flagged
a sentence with more commas is flagged
no number or quantity of people, reviews, or results that does not exist
quantity words the invented-proof rule reads before a term, such as thousands of
no scarcity or urgency phrase
phrases no word or phrase rule counts
no copy uses a loss-framed phrase
asks a message to a creator may not make; a post is not read for them
